tasks.prepare: deno task install && deno task fonts && deno task share:fonts && deno task themes && deno task licenses && deno task build:info
tasks.dev: deno task content:fetch && deno task prepare && deno task model && (deno task model:watch & hugo server --config frontend/tui/hugo.toml --renderToMemory)
tasks.build: deno task content:fetch && deno task content:check && deno task model && deno task prepare && hugo build --config frontend/tui/hugo.toml --minify --cleanDestinationDir
tasks.content:verify: deno task content:check && deno task model && deno task prepare && hugo build --config frontend/tui/hugo.toml --minify --cleanDestinationDir --destination generated/content-check
tasks.build:fixtures: deno task prepare && deno task content:check tests/fixtures/content && deno task model tests/fixtures/content && hugo build --minify --cleanDestinationDir --config frontend/tui/hugo.toml,frontend/tui/tests/fixtures/hugo.toml --destination generated/fixture-site
tasks.lint: biome ci . && taplo fmt --check && taplo lint && actionlint && deno task conventions
tasks.typecheck: deno check tools tests frontend/tui/tools frontend/tui/tests frontend/tui/assets/ts && deno task app:check
tasks.test:e2e: deno task build:fixtures && deno task validate:html && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env --allow-run frontend/tui/tests/e2e
tasks.check: deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test
tasks.ci: deno task check && deno task test:e2e && deno task test:app
tasks.app:build: cd frontend/app && deno run -A npm:vite build
tasks.app:build:fixtures: deno task prepare && deno task content:check tests/fixtures/content && deno task model tests/fixtures/content && cd frontend/app && APP_OUT=../../generated/fixture-app deno run -A npm:vite build
tasks.app:browsers: deno run -A npm:@playwright/test install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit
tasks.test:app: deno task app:build:fixtures && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test test --config frontend/app/playwright.config.ts
